nodes.text:
# Welcome to Obsidian Canvas

This text node supports **bold**, *italic*, and `code`.

- List item one
- List item two

> A blockquote for emphasis

## Markdown Features

Visit [Rspress](https://rspress.dev) for docs. Tag: #canvas #rspress/demo

> [!tip] Did you know?
> Canvas renders callouts, math, and diagrams.

Inline math: $E = mc^2$. A note[^1].

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Start] --> B[End]
```

[^1]: A footnote body.

## Highlights

A card renders ==highlights== with the same rule a note page uses, so the span ends where it ends there. A bare `====` run is left alone, and inline code is protected, so `==this stays literal==`.

Also: [[create a link|a wikilink]], #canvas, and a callout:

> [!warning] Careful
> A malformed card no longer takes the whole board down.

## Section Embeds

A card can embed one section of a note rather than the whole file. This is `![[guide/intro#Transclusion Target]]`:

![[guide/intro#Transclusion Target]]

And a block reference, `![[guide/intro#^anchor-demo]]`:

![[guide/intro#^anchor-demo]]

A heading the note does not have falls back to the whole note instead of an empty card.

nodes.fileContent:
A vault-level intro page reachable at `/vault/guide/intro`.

Back to [[Welcome|Welcome home]].

## Transclusion Target

A canvas card can embed exactly this section and nothing else — the card and a
note page slice a section with the same rules, so the two cannot drift. The
board in this vault points a text card at this heading.

## Block Anchors

A block id is a line of its own, and `[[Note#^id]]` or `![[Note#^id]]` reaches
it. This paragraph carries one: ^anchor-demo

> A standalone `^id` refers to the paragraph above it; a trailing ` ^id` refers
> to the line it sits on. Both are indexed and both resolve.

## Daily Notes

Daily notes are filed by date. The documentation site's own
[tag and daily-note page](/markdown/guide/tags-and-daily-notes) covers what a vault produces.

That link is a plain Markdown link on purpose: a note inside the vault resolves
against the vault's own index, so a `[[wikilink]]` from here can only name
another vault note. A docs page is reached by its published route.
